purpose: A Bernard quotation encouraging whole-Bible reading.

defaults.author: Thomas Dehany Bernard
defaults.sourceTitle: The Progress of Doctrine in the New Testament
defaults.rightsBasis: 1873 edition, public domain in the USA. Wording matched to stored OCR; page-scan verification pending.
defaults.reviewNote: Read in the surrounding preface. Author's observation, not Scripture; use KJV for accompanying Bible text.

entries.title: Readers of the Whole Bible
entries.text: But there is an ever increasing number who are not only readers of texts, and chapters, and books, but in a more entire sense readers of the Bible.
entries.slideText: But there is an ever increasing number who are not only readers of texts, and chapters, and books, but in a more entire sense readers of the Bible.
entries.recommendedUse: Encourage readers to study the Bible as a unified whole rather than isolated verses only.
